Sentence case only inside paper records and message threads (receipt lines, return-summary lines, AIO / client messages) for document legibility (IDNTY_09).

type.mono: IBM Plex Mono only for confirmation numbers and receipt references — the thermal-print detail (proposal)
type.implementation_note: No single global text-transform over inputs and records (legacy implementation discarded); casing applied by role
